name: claude-signal
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the signal-channel Claude Code plugin

plugins.name: signal
plugins.description: Signal messaging integration via signal-cli's JSON-RPC bridge. Inbound DMs, groups, attachments, edits, reactions, and receipts surface as channel notifications; outbound goes through the reply tool. Includes group/contact/profile management, allowlist + pairing access control, and optional persistent message history.
